feed.title: Vidhana — Sri Lankan IRD tax and VAT gazettes — stamp-duty
feed.subtitle: What changed in the Sri Lankan Inland Revenue gazettes, and what the rule is now. Derived from https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/sitepages/gazette.aspx?menuid=1602

entry.title: 2429/39 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/19
entry.content:
From 1 April 2025, stamp duty on instruments for leasing or hiring property is set at Rs. 20 for every Rs. 1,000 (or part) of the total amount payable over the lease or hire term, including any premium. If the term exceeds 20 years, the calculation is limited to the amount payable for the first 20 years. Hire-purchase agreements made under the Consumer Credit Act are charged Rs. 10 for every Rs. 1,000 (or part) of the total amount payable.
Amends 1465/19 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Section 3 - Re. Stamp Duty for Affidavit, Policy of Insurance & etc..
Effective from 2025-04-01.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2025_2429-39_E.pdf

entry.title: 2312/73 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/20
entry.content:
The order adds a new category to the stamp-duty schedule for leases of land within the Colombo Port City Economic Commission’s area of authority. It covers leases by the Commission where the lessee does not pay the lease premium, rent or other consideration in cash to the Government or the Commission, under an agreement to which the Government is a party; the treatment applies from the date the Port City Commission Act came into force.
Amends 1465/20 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Sec. 5. Re. Affidavit & Mortgages by Public Officers.
Effective from 2022-12-31.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
(Summary confidence: medium. The gazette itself is the source of truth.)
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2022_2312-73_E.pdf

entry.title: 2149/18 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/20
entry.content:
This Order added a new Schedule item covering instruments for leases of land by the Government, government representatives or the Urban Development Authority where the lease premium or rent is not paid in cash and the agreement involves the Government. The position was later amended by Gazette 2312/73, which also covers qualifying leases of land in the Colombo Port City area by the Colombo Port City Economic Commission, from the commencement of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act.
Amends 1465/20 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Sec. 5. Re. Affidavit & Mortgages by Public Officers.
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2019-11-14.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2019_2149-18_E.pdf

entry.title: 2104/05 [stamp-duty] rescinds 2091/03 and amends 1465/19
entry.content:
From 1 January 2019, this Order changed stamp duty on specified trade, business, profession and vocation licences: non-liquor licences are charged Rs. 2,000 or 10% of the licence fee, whichever is lower; most liquor licences are charged Rs. 20,000; and certain listed liquor licences are charged Rs. 2,000 or 10% of the licence fee, whichever is higher. As amended by Gazette 2429/39 from 1 April 2025, stamp duty also applies to leases and hire agreements at Rs. 20 per Rs. 1,000 of the total amount for the term, or Rs. 10 per Rs. 1,000 for qualifying hire-purchase agreements.
Amends 1465/19 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Section 3 - Re. Stamp Duty for Affidavit, Policy of Insurance & etc..
Rescinds 2091/03 — Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act No. 12 of 2006 - Order under Section 3.
The current document in this rule is now 2429/39 (2025-03-27).
Effective from 2019-01-01.
Affects: parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2018_2104-05_E.pdf

entry.title: 2091/03 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/19
entry.content:
From 1 October 2018, item 04 stamp-duty rates for trade, business, professional and vocational licences were replaced: non-liquor licences were charged Rs. 2,000 or 10% of the licence fee, whichever was lower; most liquor licences Rs. 20,000; and specified arrack and bottled-toddy licences Rs. 2,000 or 10% of the licence fee, whichever was higher. Gazette 2091/03 was rescinded by Gazette 2104/05 with effect from 1 January 2019, which re-enacted these rates in a replacement item 04; this is the position as amended.
Amends 1465/19 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Section 3 - Re. Stamp Duty for Affidavit, Policy of Insurance & etc..
The current document in this rule is now 2429/39 (2025-03-27).
Effective from 2018-10-01.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2018_2091-03_E.pdf

entry.title: 2007/24 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/20
entry.content:
From 21 February 2017, the order changes which instruments are exempt from stamp duty: specified life, medical, construction/agriculture and motor-vehicle insurance policies, qualifying finance leases, and qualifying hire-purchase agreements. In practice, finance leases and hire-purchase agreements for Class B cars and dual-purpose motor vehicles are excluded from these exemptions. As amended by Gazette 2149/18, the order also covers certain non-cash government or Urban Development Authority land leases; that later gazette does not state a separate effective date.
Amends 1465/20 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Sec. 5. Re. Affidavit & Mortgages by Public Officers.
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2017-02-21.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2017_2007_24_E.pdf

entry.title: 1947/46 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/20
entry.content:
The order adds two categories to the Stamp Duty Schedule: claims, demands or requests for payment arising from Sri Lankan-merchant credit card transactions entered into on or after 1 January 2016, and share certificates issued following the issue, transfer or assignment of shares. Gazette 2007/24 later amended other Schedule items but did not change these additions, so this remains the position as amended. Businesses and notaries should assess the stamp-duty treatment of these transactions and documents from the stated date.
Amends 1465/20 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Sec. 5. Re. Affidavit & Mortgages by Public Officers.
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2016-01-01.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2016_1947_46_E.pdf

entry.title: 1947/45 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/19
entry.content:
Item 05 of the stamp-duty schedule was replaced for credit-card transactions entered into from 1 January 2016. A charge of Rs. 25 applies for every Rs. 1,000 or part of Rs. 1,000 claimed, demanded or requested, excluding finance and service charges, where the merchant country is outside Sri Lanka; this applies whether the card was present or not and in any currency.
Amends 1465/19 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Section 3 - Re. Stamp Duty for Affidavit, Policy of Insurance & etc..
The current document in this rule is now 2429/39 (2025-03-27).
Effective from 2016-01-01.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
(Summary confidence: medium. The gazette itself is the source of truth.)
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2016_1947_45_E.pdf

entry.title: 1933/14 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/19
entry.content:
Item 07 was replaced to set stamp duty on every bond or mortgage securing a definite and certain sum at Rs. 1 for every Rs. 1,000 or part of Rs. 1,000. As amended by Gazette 1947/45, this item 07 rate remains unchanged; that later Gazette replaced item 05 instead.
Amends 1465/19 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Section 3 - Re. Stamp Duty for Affidavit, Policy of Insurance & etc..
The current document in this rule is now 2429/39 (2025-03-27).
Effective from 2015-09-21.
Affects: notaries; parties to bonds and mortgages that secure a definite and certain sum of money.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2015_1933_14_E.pdf

entry.title: 1889/48 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/20
entry.content:
As amended by Gazette 1947/46 from 1 January 2016, the order replaces the existing item for insurance-company share certificates and adds coverage for certain share certificates issued after the consolidation of licensed banks, finance companies or leasing companies. It also covers claims for payment arising from Sri Lankan-merchant credit-card transactions made on or after 1 January 2016, whether card-present or card-not-present and in any currency. The practical effect of these schedule entries depends on what the original 2006 order provides for instruments listed in its Schedule.
Amends 1465/20 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Sec. 5. Re. Affidavit & Mortgages by Public Officers.
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2014-11-21.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
(Summary confidence: medium. The gazette itself is the source of truth.)
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2014_1889-48_E.pdf

entry.title: 1882/17 [stamp-duty] rescinds 1465/19, 1864/02
entry.content:
The stamp duty rule for item 06 is replaced. Share certificates issued following the issue, transfer or assignment of company shares attract duty of Rs. 5 for every Rs. 1,000 or part of Rs. 1,000 of the shares’ aggregate open-market value, as assessed by the relevant revenue official; the earlier Order published as Gazette 1864/02 is also rescinded.
Rescinds 1465/19 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Section 3 - Re. Stamp Duty for Affidavit, Policy of Insurance & etc..
Rescinds 1864/02 — Order to amend the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 2006 -(Re Shares).
The current document in this rule is now 2429/39 (2025-03-27).
Effective from 2014-09-30.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2014_1882-17_E.pdf

entry.title: 1878/03 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/20
entry.content:
The order added a category for share certificates issued when an insurance company separates its long-term and general insurance businesses, subject to the stated value limit. As amended by Gazette 1889/48, item 32 now contains revised wording for that insurance-business separation, and a new item 33 covers share certificates issued after approved mergers, acquisitions or absorptions involving certain banks, finance companies or leasing companies.
Amends 1465/20 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Sec. 5. Re. Affidavit & Mortgages by Public Officers.
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2014-09-01.
Affects: parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2014_1878-03_E.pdf

entry.title: 1864/02 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/19
entry.content:
This Order originally set stamp duty on share certificates at Rs. 5 for every Rs. 1,000, or part thereof, of the shares’ aggregate open-market value at issue, transfer or assignment. That provision was rescinded by Gazette 1882/17, so the original share-certificate rate no longer applies as issued here. Gazette 1933/14 later amended the underlying Schedule by setting duty on bonds or mortgages at Rs. 1 per Rs. 1,000, or part thereof; it did not restore the rescinded share-certificate provision.
Amends 1465/19 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Section 3 - Re. Stamp Duty for Affidavit, Policy of Insurance & etc..
The current document in this rule is now 2429/39 (2025-03-27).
Effective from 2014-05-26.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
(Summary confidence: medium. The gazette itself is the source of truth.)
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2014_1864_02_(E).pdf

entry.title: 1809/19 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/19
entry.content:
From 13 May 2013, the stamp duty on any affidavit is Rs. 50.00. As amended by Gazette 1882/17, this affidavit rate remains unchanged; the later amendment dealt with share certificates instead.
Amends 1465/19 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Section 3 - Re. Stamp Duty for Affidavit, Policy of Insurance & etc..
The current document in this rule is now 2429/39 (2025-03-27).
Effective from 2013-05-13.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2013_1809_19 (E).pdf

entry.title: 1789/15 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/20
entry.content:
From 1 January 2013, the order adds instruments transferring stocks to a margin trading account (slash account), or back from that account, to the relevant Stamp Duty schedule. This changes the stamp-duty treatment of those stock transfers under the amended order.
Amends 1465/20 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Sec. 5. Re. Affidavit & Mortgages by Public Officers.
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2013-01-01.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2012_1789_15 (E).pdf

entry.title: 1789/09 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/19
entry.content:
This order replaced the stamp-duty rates for affidavits, insurance policies, notary warrants, business and liquor licences, and credit-card payment claims, applying from 1 January 2013. As amended by Gazette 1809/19, from 13 May 2013 the affidavit rate is Rs. 50 instead of the Rs. 250 rate originally set by this gazette; the other listed rates remain as stated here.
Amends 1465/19 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Section 3 - Re. Stamp Duty for Affidavit, Policy of Insurance & etc..
The current document in this rule is now 2429/39 (2025-03-27).
Effective from 2013-01-01.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2012_1789_09 (E).pdf

entry.title: 1778/32 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/20
entry.content:
This order added a stamp-duty schedule item for share certificates issued when one Government-owned company issues shares to another, or when a qualifying Strategic Development Project company issues shares to a Government-owned company. As amended by Gazette 1878/03, this provision is now numbered item 31; that later gazette also added a separate item for certain insurance-company share certificates. Gazette 1789/15 separately added an item for transfers of stocks to or from margin trading accounts, effective from 1 January 2013.
Amends 1465/20 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Sec. 5. Re. Affidavit & Mortgages by Public Officers.
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2012-10-04.
Affects: companies covered by an agreement with the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka under the Strategic Development Project Act issuing shares to a Government-owned company; companies issuing qualifying shares to other companies owned by the Government of Sri Lanka; notaries.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2012_1778_32 (E).pdf

entry.title: 1757/04 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/20
entry.content:
This Gazette adds a new item to the stamp-duty order covering share certificates on the transfer or assignment of shares belonging to the Government of Sri Lanka. As amended by Gazette 1778/32, the schedule also covers share certificates for the initial issue of shares by specified companies to a Government-owned company. The supplied text does not state the applicable rate or exemption effect of these schedule entries.
Amends 1465/20 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Sec. 5. Re. Affidavit & Mortgages by Public Officers.
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2012-05-09.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2012_1757_04 (E).pdf

entry.title: 1752/17 [stamp-duty] amends 1546/07
entry.content:
The order adds share certificates issued for shares to the Government of Sri Lanka as a new item in the relevant Stamp Duty schedule. As amended by Gazette 1757/04, the schedule also includes share certificates for the transfer or assignment of shares belonging to the Government of Sri Lanka.
Amends 1546/07 — Stamp Duty Special Provisions Act No. 12 of 2006 - Amendment to Gaz Ex. No. 1465/20 of 05.10.2006.
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2012-04-04.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2012_1752_17 (E).pdf

entry.title: 1546/07 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/20
entry.content:
This order replaces item 13 in the earlier stamp-duty schedule, covering deeds of mortgage or lease affecting aircraft registered under the Air Navigation Act or ships registered under the Merchant Shipping Act. As amended by Gazette 1752/17 dated 4 April 2012, the schedule also includes share certificates issued for shares to the Government of Sri Lanka.
Amends 1465/20 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Sec. 5. Re. Affidavit & Mortgages by Public Officers.
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2008-04-22.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/20081546_7(E).pdf

entry.title: 1530/13 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/19
entry.content:
From 1 January 2008, this order changed stamp duty for business and liquor licences, and made receipts or discharges for amounts up to Rs. 25,000 exempt while charging Rs. 25 above that amount. The licence rates were later replaced by Gazette 1789/09 from 1 January 2013: Rs. 2,000 or 10% of the licence fee (whichever is lower) for most licences, and Rs. 20,000 for liquor licences; the receipt rules remain as stated here.
Amends 1465/19 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Section 3 - Re. Stamp Duty for Affidavit, Policy of Insurance & etc..
The current document in this rule is now 2429/39 (2025-03-27).
Effective from 2008-01-01.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/20081530_13[E].pdf

entry.title: 1478/07 [stamp-duty] amends 1465/20
entry.content:
As amended by Gazette 1478/07, the schedule under the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act now includes two additional categories: unit trust or mutual fund certificates, and specified instruments involving Regional Development Banks, including loan security documents. The change applies from 1 January 2007 and updates the earlier Order published in Gazette 1465/20.
Amends 1465/20 — Stamp Duty Act - Order under Sec. 5. Re. Affidavit & Mortgages by Public Officers.
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2007-01-01.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/20071478_7(E).pdf

entry.title: 1465/20 [stamp-duty] rescinds 1439/02, 1441/18
entry.content:
This Order exempts specified instruments from stamp duty from 6 October 2006, including affidavits requested by public officers, bonds and mortgages given by public officers, certain insurance policies, mortgages, leases, receipts, share certificates and court documents. As amended by later gazettes, including 2312/73, the exemptions also cover qualifying government, financial-sector and share transactions, certain credit-card claims, and specified leases involving the Colombo Port City Economic Commission. The exemptions apply only where the relevant instrument falls within the listed conditions.
Rescinds 1439/02 — (recovered from the Internet Archive; not in the IRD listing).
Rescinds 1441/18 — (recovered from the Internet Archive; not in the IRD listing).
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2006-10-06.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2006_1465-20_E.pdf

entry.title: 1465/19 [stamp-duty] rescinds 1439/01, 1441/17
entry.content:
This Order made stamp duty chargeable from 6 October 2006 on specified instruments, including affidavits, insurance policies, notary warrants, licences, credit-card claims, share certificates, mortgages, promissory notes, leases, hire-purchase agreements and receipts. It replaced the earlier Orders in Gazettes 1439/01 and 1441/17. As amended by Gazette 2429/39, from 1 April 2025 the stamp duty on leases and hires is Rs. 20 per Rs. 1,000 of the total amount payable, while hire-purchase agreements are charged at Rs. 10 per Rs. 1,000; several other items have also been changed by later amendments.
Rescinds 1439/01 — (recovered from the Internet Archive; not in the IRD listing).
Rescinds 1441/17 — (recovered from the Internet Archive; not in the IRD listing).
The current document in this rule is now 2429/39 (2025-03-27).
Effective from 2006-10-06.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2006_1465-19_E.pdf

entry.title: 1441/18 [stamp-duty] amends 1439/02
entry.content:
From 21 April 2006, this Order changed the stamp-duty exemptions in the earlier 3 April Order: it replaced the exemption for certain house-related mortgages, replaced the exemption for bank and finance-company deposit or withdrawal receipts, and added exemptions for instruments involving the Government, immediate receipts for goods or services, and death gratuities or compensation. As amended by Gazette 1465/20, the Order was rescinded from 6 October 2006, so those 1441/18 exemptions no longer apply from that date and the replacement schedule in 1465/20 governs instead.
Amends 1439/02 — (recovered from the Internet Archive; not in the IRD listing).
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2006-04-21.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
(Summary confidence: medium. The gazette itself is the source of truth.)
Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20241121131501if_/http://www.documents.gov.lk/old/gazette/forms/Extgzt/2006/Pdf/Apr/1441-18/1441-18e.pdf

entry.title: 1441/17 [stamp-duty] amends 1439/01
entry.content:
This Order changed the stamp duty on receipts and discharges from 21 April 2006. Receipts for money or property were charged Rs. 1 per Rs. 1,000 for amounts below Rs. 50,000, or Rs. 50 for amounts of Rs. 50,000 or more; employee remuneration of Rs. 25,000 or less was exempt, with higher fixed charges for larger amounts. As amended by Gazette 1465/19, this Order was rescinded from 6 October 2006 and was replaced by a new stamp-duty schedule.
Amends 1439/01 — (recovered from the Internet Archive; not in the IRD listing).
The current document in this rule is now 2429/39 (2025-03-27).
Effective from 2006-04-21.
Affects: parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20241121131450if_/http://www.documents.gov.lk/old/gazette/forms/Extgzt/2006/Pdf/Apr/1441-17/1441-17e.pdf

entry.title: 1439/03 [stamp-duty] new: Stamp Duty Act, no. 43 of 1982 - Order under Section 69
entry.content:
This Order rescinds the previous stamp-duty order dated 20 December 1982 and all amendments to it. From 4 April 2006, stamp duty applies to gifts, transfers of immovable property and specified court documents at the rates set out in the Schedule, including tiered rates based on value.
Effective from 2006-04-04.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2006_1439-03_E.pdf

entry.title: 1439/02 [stamp-duty] new: (recovered from the Internet Archive; not in the IRD listing)
entry.content:
This Order exempted a range of instruments from stamp duty, including certain mortgages, building leases or rents, receipts, insurance policies and court documents. As amended by Gazette 1441/18 from 21 April 2006, it changed some exemptions and added others; Gazette 1465/20 then rescinded the entire Order from 6 October 2006, so these exemptions no longer apply under this Order after that date.
The current document in this rule is now 2312/73 (2022-12-31).
Effective from 2006-04-03.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20241121131240if_/http://www.documents.gov.lk/old/gazette/forms/Extgzt/2006/Pdf/Apr/1439-2/1439-2e.pdf

entry.title: 1439/01 [stamp-duty] new: (recovered from the Internet Archive; not in the IRD listing)
entry.content:
This Order imposed stamp duty from 4 April 2006 on specified instruments, including affidavits, insurance policies, notary warrants, business licences, credit-card claims, share transactions, mortgages, promissory notes, leases and receipts. As amended by Gazette 1441/17 from 21 April 2006, receipts for employee remuneration of Rs. 25,000 or less were exempt, with revised charges applying above that amount. The Order was rescinded from 6 October 2006 by Gazette 1465/19 and replaced by a new order.
The current document in this rule is now 2429/39 (2025-03-27).
Effective from 2006-04-04.
Affects: notaries; parties to leases, transfers and other stampable instruments.
Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20241121131244if_/http://www.documents.gov.lk/old/gazette/forms/Extgzt/2006/Pdf/Apr/1439-1/1439-1e.pdf
